# third_party/appsdk — app-SDK headers for engine/wpeqt

Public headers and pkg-config files that let `engine/wpeqt` compile against WPE WebKit 2.48.5
without building WebKit. **Headers, `.pc` files and license texts only, no binaries.** The matching
`.so` files come from the upstream rmweb 0.9.7 release (`build/release/rmweb-0.9.7/lib`, not committed).

`./scripts/fast-build.sh app` copies `usr/` into the SDK sysroot inside the `rmweb-sdk` container,
then builds `build/wifi-signin-wpeqt`.

This tree stands in for the `wpewebkit-2.48.5.tar.xz` package source in the spec (§7).
See the plan's Task 17 for why the build uses it.

## What is in `usr/`

| Path | What | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `include/wpe-webkit-2.0/wpe` | WebKit UI-process API (`wpe-webkit-2.0`) | 69 headers |
| `include/wpe-webkit-2.0/jsc` | JavaScriptCore GLib API | 10 headers |
| `include/wpe-webkit-2.0/wpe-platform` | WPEPlatform API (`wpe-platform-2.0`), incl. headless | 28 headers |
| `include/wpe-1.0` | libwpe 1.16 | 16 headers |
| `include/libsoup-3.0` | libsoup 3.6 | 42 headers |
| `include/xkbcommon` | libxkbcommon 1.7 | 5 headers |
| `lib/pkgconfig` | `wpe-webkit-2.0`, `wpe-platform-2.0`, `wpe-1.0`, `libsoup-3.0` | 4 `.pc` files |

170 headers and 4 `.pc` files in all, about 1.3 MB. All are text. `prefix=/usr`, so
pkg-config resolves them under the SDK sysroot.

## What is in `LICENSES/`

The license texts that go with the headers (11 files, about 165 KB). See "Licenses" below for which
header is covered by which.

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `LICENSES/webkit/` | From `wpewebkit-2.48.5.tar.xz`: `LICENSE-LGPL-2`, `LICENSE-LGPL-2.1`, `LICENSE-APPLE` (`Source/WebCore/`) and `COPYING.LIB` (`Source/JavaScriptCore/`, the file the WebKit headers point at) |
| `LICENSES/debian/` | The Debian `copyright` file of `libwpe-1.0-dev`, `libsoup-3.0-dev` and `libxkbcommon-dev` (real files in these packages) |
| `LICENSES/common-licenses/` | Full texts from the pinned image's `/usr/share/common-licenses` that the copyright files and headers refer to: `LGPL-2`, `LGPL-2.1`, `MPL-2.0` (named by libsoup's copyright file, for a test file that is not vendored here) and `Apache-2.0` (libwpe's `wpe/gamepad.h`) |

## Provenance

Generated by `engine/gen-app-sdk.incontainer.sh` (ported from rmbrowser, MIT), run by
`./scripts/fast-build.sh sdk`, which writes `build/appsdk/usr` and `build/appsdk/LICENSES`. They are
copied to `third_party/appsdk/usr` and `third_party/appsdk/LICENSES`:

- WebKit and JSC headers come from `wpewebkit-2.48.5.tar.xz`
  (SHA-256 `01f36010705adb14404c56baf033147f7927cc7c6badec81bb141266fcdd8d0b`, the value pinned in
  `scripts/build-wpe.sh`). The script renders the GLib API templates with WebKit's own
  `generate-api-header.py` and `glib-mkenums`, as WebKit's CMake install rules do. `WPEConfig.h`
  is configured with the headless platform on and DRM and Wayland off.
- libwpe, libsoup and libxkbcommon headers come from the Debian trixie `-dev` packages. They
  match the 0.9.7 bundle's `.so` ABI. The packages used for this tree:
  `libwpe-1.0-dev_1.16.2-1_arm64`, `libsoup-3.0-dev_3.6.5-3_arm64`,
  `libxkbcommon-dev_1.7.0-2_arm64`.
- The generator container is `debian:trixie` pinned by digest in `scripts/fast-build.sh`
  (`sha256:4c25275446ca371766b8b093c696782eabce06263fccacb8d5d813b3dc44b308`, trixie-20261020).
- The `.pc` files are written by the script (they carry the versions above, not Debian's own files).
- `LICENSES/` is copied by the same script: the four WebKit license files from the tarball (`fast-build.sh`
  adds them to the members it extracts), the three `copyright` files from the extracted `.deb`s, and the
  `common-licenses` texts from the pinned image. The script fails if a `-dev` package ever stops shipping a
  regular `copyright` file.

The tree was generated on 2026-10-26.

## Regenerate

```sh
./scripts/fast-build.sh sdk                 # writes build/appsdk/usr and build/appsdk/LICENSES
diff -r build/appsdk/usr third_party/appsdk/usr                # empty output = the committed headers are reproducible
diff -r build/appsdk/LICENSES third_party/appsdk/LICENSES      # same for the license texts
```

Regeneration installs the current trixie `-dev` packages, so a later run can differ from the committed
tree; diff it against `third_party/appsdk/usr` before replacing anything. Compare the `[appsdk] debs:`
line of the run with the versions above.

To replace the committed trees, run
`rm -rf third_party/appsdk/usr third_party/appsdk/LICENSES && cp -R build/appsdk/usr build/appsdk/LICENSES third_party/appsdk/`.

## Licenses

Many headers carry their own license notice. The libsoup headers mostly do not: 7 of the 42 carry an LGPL
notice, the generated `soup-enum-types.h` only says it follows the project license, and the other 34 have
none. Those are covered by the package copyright files in `LICENSES/debian/` (libsoup is LGPL-2+ for the
package). The other groups carry a notice in every header. The full texts are in `LICENSES/`.

| Headers | License |
|---|---|
| WebKit and JSC (`wpe-webkit-2.0/wpe`, `wpe-webkit-2.0/jsc`) | LGPL-2.0+ or LGPL-2.1+ per file. Three files are BSD-2-Clause (`WebKitUserContentFilterStore.h`, `WebKitDefines.h`, `jsc/JSCDefines.h`); `WebKitSettings.h` is BSD-3-Clause. Texts: `LICENSES/webkit/`, `LICENSES/common-licenses/LGPL-2*` |
| WPEPlatform (`wpe-webkit-2.0/wpe-platform`) | BSD-2-Clause |
| libsoup (`libsoup-3.0`) | LGPL-2.0+; `soup-websocket.h` and `soup-websocket-connection.h` are LGPL-2.1+ |
| libwpe (`wpe-1.0`) | BSD-2-Clause, except `wpe/gamepad.h` (Apache-2.0) and `wpe/keysyms.h` (X11, The Open Group) |
| libxkbcommon (`xkbcommon`) | MIT/X11 |

The `.pc` files are written by the generator, which is a port of rmbrowser's `gen-app-sdk.incontainer.sh`
(MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Eugene Tarakanov and contributors; see the top-level `NOTICE`). The `.pc` files
and the build scripts are covered by the top-level `LICENSE` (MIT). The app links WebKit and libsoup
dynamically.
